blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Adverse conditions such as rain, snow, fog, and dust remain challenging for camera-based perception in autonomous driving. We study multi-class weather recognition from street-view images under domain shift, where most available training data come from non–street-view sources that differ markedly from real driving scenes. We propose Weather-Aware Adversarial Discriminative Domain Adaptation (WA-ADDA), which conditions the domain discriminator on predicted weather to promote features that are both domain-invariant and weather-sensitive. We also assemble a multi-dataset benchmark by unifying diverse non–street-view weather collections as sources and real street-view images as targets, and define a standardized evaluation protocol with macro accuracy as the primary metric. Across backbones (ResNet-50, EfficientNet, VGG, DenseNet), WA-ADDA consistently improves street-view performance and yields strong per-class recalls in challenging conditions while preserving clear-weather accuracy. These findings highlight the feasibility of domain-adapted weather recognition and the value of our benchmark for advancing robust, on-board perception.
blocks.zh: 雨、雪、雾和灰尘等不利条件对自主驾驶时的相机感知仍然具有挑战性。 我们研究多级天气识别, 由街景图像在域名转换下, 我们提出“天气-敏感”区分域适应(WA-ADDA),它将域歧视者在预测天气上的条件作为促进既具有域变量又具有天气敏感性的特征的条件。 我们还通过将不同的非街头观天气收集作为源头和真实的街头观图像作为目标来整合一个多数据集基准,并定义一个以宏观精确度作为主要衡量标准的标准化评价协议。 纵观主干网(ResNet-50、高效率网、VGG、DenseNet),WA-ADDA不断改进街景表现,并在挑战性条件下产生强劲的每个阶级召回,同时保持晴天的准确性。 这些结论突出了根据域调整的天气识别的可行性,以及我们推进稳健的上载认知的基准的价值。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Autonomous driving spans levels from driver assistance to full autonomy, where safe operation hinges on reliable perception. Among on-board sensors, cameras are central: they capture rich scene cues used for detection, tracking, and control. Yet camera-based perception degrades under adverse weather. Rain, snow, fog, and dust reduce contrast and visibility, obscure road markings, and introduce artifacts (e.g., raindrops on windshields, specular glare), degrading object detection and lane following. Automatically recognizing weather from images is thus a practical perception subtask that can support downstream safety logic (e.g., adaptive speed policies, sensor-fusion reweighting, and dynamic sensitivity of pedestrian and lane detectors).
blocks.zh: 自主驾驶从驾驶员协助到完全自主不等,安全操作取决于可靠的感觉。 在机上传感器中,相机为中心:它们捕捉出用于探测,跟踪和控制的丰富的场景提示. 然而相机感知在恶劣天气下会退化. 雨、雪、雾和灰尘会减少对比和能见度、模糊的路标,并引进文物(如挡风玻璃上的雨滴、光谱光等)、有辱人格的物体探测和跟踪道。 因此,从图像中自动识别天气是一个实用的感知子任务,可以支持下游的安全逻辑(例如适应速度政策,感知-聚变再加权,以及行人和道道探测器的动态敏感性等).

blocks.en: External weather services (global feeds, satellite/radar) are invaluable but often coarse in space and time and may miss on-scene phenomena critical to vision: local fog banks, brief dust plumes, wet-but-not-raining pavement, or residual snow on the road despite no active snowfall. In contrast, the ego camera provides immediate, localized evidence even when connectivity is limited. Therefore, image-based weather recognition is essential for on-board perception, enabling timely, localized adaptation of detection and control.
blocks.zh: 外部气象服务(全球饲料、卫星/雷达)是宝贵的,但往往在空间和时间上都很粗糙,可能会错过对视觉至关重要的现场现象:局部雾库、短暂的尘埃羽流、湿润但排不入地道,或者尽管没有发生活性降雪,但路上仍有残留的雪。 相形之下,自我相机提供即时的,局部的证据,即使连接有限. 因此,基于图像的天气识别对机载感知至关重要,能够及时、局部地适应探测和控制。

blocks.en: Despite substantial work on detection and segmentation in adverse weather, direct multi-class weather recognition for street-view images remains relatively underexplored. Most available datasets are non–street-view or synthetically augmented, and domain shift—differences in viewpoint, optics, and scene composition—causes models trained on one dataset to generalize poorly to real driving imagery.
blocks.zh: 尽管在恶劣天气中进行了大量探测和分化工作,但街道景观图象的直接多级天气识别仍然相对未得到充分探索。 大部分可用的数据集是非街景或合成增强的,域位转移——观点、光学和场景构成的偏差——导致在一个数据集上训练的模型被概括为不善于真实驱动图像。

blocks.en: Domain adaptation (DA) addresses such shifts by aligning feature distributions between labeled sources and unlabeled targets. Adversarial Discriminative Domain Adaptation (ADDA) is a widely used two-stage approach: supervised pretraining on labeled source data, followed by adversarial alignment on unlabeled target data. However, generic ADDA does not exploit weather-specific structure that could stabilize alignment and preserve class semantics under adverse conditions.
blocks.zh: 域适应(DA)通过调整被标出源与被标出目标之间的特征分布来解决这种变化. 横向差别域适应(ADDA)是一种被广泛应用的分两个阶段的方法:对标有标记的源数据进行监督的预训,然后对未标有标记的目标数据进行对抗性校正. 然而,一般的ADA并没有利用在不利条件下能够稳定对等并保存类语义的针对天气的结构.

blocks.en: We study street-view weather recognition under severe domain shift and make the following contributions: • Weather-Aware ADDA (WA-ADDA). We augment ADDA with a weather-conditioned discriminator that takes both features and predicted class probabilities, encouraging representations that are domain-invariant yet weather-sensitive. • Multi-dataset benchmark and protocol. We unify diverse, publicly available non–street-view weather datasets as sources and evaluate on street-view targets, providing a standardized protocol where macro accuracy serves as the primary evaluation metric to account for inter-class imbalance. • Comprehensive evaluation. We compare strong backbones (e.g., EfficientNet, ResNet-50, DenseNet, VGG) with and without adaptation, showing that WA-ADDA improves target-domain performance under challenging weather conditions (e.g., fog, sand) while maintaining accuracy on clear-weather scenes.
blocks.zh: 我们在严重领域转移下研究街道景观天气识别,并作出以下贡献: 我们用一个既具有特征又具有预测等级概率的气候条件的区别对待者来增强非洲工业发展十年,鼓励那些具有域-变量却对天气敏感的表述。 • 多数据集基准和协议。 我们统一了多种公开的非街头观测天气数据集作为源头,并对街景目标进行评估,提供一种标准化的协议,其中宏观准确性是衡量阶级间失衡的主要评价指标。 • 综合评价。 我们把强大的骨干网(如:高效网、ResNet-50、DenseNet、VGG)与或不作调整进行比较,显示WA-ADDA在有挑战性的天气条件下(如雾、沙等)改进目标领域的业绩,同时保持晴天场景的准确性。

blocks.en: Weather-Aware ADDA (WA-ADDA). We augment ADDA with a weather-conditioned discriminator that takes both features and predicted class probabilities, encouraging representations that are domain-invariant yet weather-sensitive.

blocks.en: Multi-dataset benchmark and protocol. We unify diverse, publicly available non–street-view weather datasets as sources and evaluate on street-view targets, providing a standardized protocol where macro accuracy serves as the primary evaluation metric to account for inter-class imbalance.

blocks.en: Comprehensive evaluation. We compare strong backbones (e.g., EfficientNet, ResNet-50, DenseNet, VGG) with and without adaptation, showing that WA-ADDA improves target-domain performance under challenging weather conditions (e.g., fog, sand) while maintaining accuracy on clear-weather scenes.

blocks.en: The rest of this paper is organized as follows: Section II reviews related work in domain adaptation and weather perception. Section III presents the proposed Weather-Aware ADDA framework. Section IV describes the datasets, benchmark protocol, and experimental results. Section V concludes with key findings and future directions.
blocks.zh: 本文件其余部分按下列方式编排: 第二节审查域内适应和天气感知方面的相关工作。 第三节介绍拟议的天气警报非洲开发部框架。 第四节介绍了数据集、基准协议和实验结果。 第五节最后提出主要结论和今后的方向。

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Weather Classification in Autonomous Driving
blocks.zh: II-A 自主驾驶的天气分类

blocks.en: While adverse weather like rain, fog, and snow considerably deteriorates performance in camera-based perception for autonomous vehicles, most existing datasets and efforts focus on detection or segmentation [ 9 , 2 , 7 ] . Weather classification itself—especially from street-view images—remains underexplored. Many datasets such as Image2Weather [ 4 ] , WSPFI [ 1 ] , and MWD [ 17 ] are non–street-view or synthetically augmented, leading to poor generalization in real-world driving scenarios. Comprehensive reviews of adverse-weather perception confirm that direct weather-type recognition is still a relatively under-addressed problem [ 3 ] .
blocks.zh: 虽然雨、雾和雪等不利天气使自动车辆的相机感知性能严重恶化,但大多数现有数据集和努力侧重于探测或分解[9、2、7]。 天气分类本身,特别是从街景图像来看,仍然没有得到充分利用。 许多数据集,如Image2Weather [4],WSPFI [1],以及MWD [17],都是非街景或合成增强,导致现实世界驱动情景中的通俗性差. 对不良天气感知的全面审查证实,直接的天气类型识别仍然是一个相对处理不足的问题[3]。

blocks.en: II-B Domain Adaptation for Visual Perception
blocks.zh: II-B 视觉视觉领域适应

blocks.en: Domain adaptation (DA) reduces the shift between source (training) and target (deployment) distributions. Adversarial DA (e.g., ADDA [ 19 ] , DANN) and discrepancy-based DA (e.g., MMD, CORAL) are established paradigms, and have been applied extensively to driving tasks under fog, rain, and snow [ 11 ] . For instance, Li et al. combine image-level and object-level adaptation with adversarial gradients to boost detection in adverse conditions [ 9 ] ; Lin et al. leverage adversarial learning and pseudo-labels for vehicle detection [ 10 ] ; and reference-free schemes such as ADVENT explore temporal cues to generalize across weather without clear-weather anchors [ 7 ] . However, these advances predominantly target detection/segmentation, not multi-class weather classification from street-view images.
blocks.zh: 域适应(DA)减少了源(培训)与目标(部署)分配之间的转移. 横向DA(如ADA[19],DANN)和基于差异的DA(如MMD,CORAL)是既定的范式,被广泛应用于雾,雨和雪下驾驶任务[11]. 以李等为例. 将图像水平和物体水平的适应与对抗梯度相结合,以在不利条件下加强检测[9]; 林等编. 利用对抗学习和假标签进行车辆探测[10];无参考计划,如ADVENT探索时间提示,在没有晴天锚的情况下将整个天气普遍化[7]。 然而,这些进步主要是目标探测/分出,而不是从街景图像中进行多级天气分出.

blocks.en: II-C Weather-Aware DA and Benchmarks
blocks.zh: II-C 天气警报数据和基准

blocks.en: Several works merge multiple adverse-weather datasets or inject weather cues to aid detection via transfer learning (e.g., YOLO-family improvements using DAWN/ACDC) [ 8 ] . New resources like CADC+ provide paired clear/snow sequences for studying DA effects on 3D detection and scene understanding [ 16 ] . To our knowledge, there is still no unified benchmark specifically for weather-type classification with DA from non–street-view sources to street-view targets, and “weather-aware” conditioning has largely been explored in detection rather than classification.
blocks.zh: 一些工程合并了多个不利天气数据集或注入了天气提示来帮助通过转移学习进行检测(例如,使用DAWN/ACDC改进YOLO-家庭) [8]. CADC+等新资源为研究DA对3D检测和场景理解的影响提供了对等的清晰/雪花序列[16]. 据我们所知,对于从非街头景源到街头景点的DA的天气类型分类,仍然没有具体的统一基准,在探测而不是分类时,基本上都探索了“天气感知”条件。

blocks.en: II-D Our Position
blocks.zh: 二-D 我们的立场

blocks.en: To fill this gap, we propose a Weather-Aware ADDA, which enhances ADDA by incorporating weather conditioning in the discriminator to learn features that are both domain-invariant and weather-sensitive. Additionally, we build the first multi-dataset benchmark for weather classification under domain adaptation. This benchmark integrates multiple non–street-view datasets and evaluates performance on street-view targets, establishing a standardized evaluation protocol. Our approach bridges the fields of adverse-weather perception and domain adaptation, with a novel emphasis on weather-type recognition for autonomous driving.
blocks.zh: 为了填补这一空白,我们提议采用天气感应ADDA,通过将天气调节纳入歧视者之中来提高ADDA,以学习既具有域变量又具有天气敏感性的特征。 此外,我们为适应域下的天气分类建立了第一个多数据集基准。 这个基准整合了多个非街景数据集并评价了街景目标上的性能,建立了标准化的评价协议. 我们的方法将不利天气感知和田地适应的领域相接而来,新的重点是自主驾驶的天气型识别.

blocks.en: IV Experiments
blocks.zh: 四. 试验

blocks.en: IV-A Datasets and Benchmark Protocol
blocks.zh: 四-A 数据集和基准议定书

blocks.en:
To evaluate the proposed WA-ADDA framework, we construct a multi-source → \rightarrow single-target weather adaptation benchmark using images selected from several publicly available datasets.
The benchmark, along with detailed data splits and metadata, is publicly available in our GitHub repository [ 13 ] 0 0 0 No original images are redistributed; the repository provides only split files/identifiers and metadata. Raw data must be obtained from the original dataset providers. .
These datasets differ in resolution, collection environments, and weather conditions, providing diverse domains for both training and evaluation.
blocks.zh:
为了评价拟议的WA-ADDA框架,我们利用从几个公开的数据集中挑选的图像,构建了一个多来源的 \\\ 右侧的单一目标天气适应基准。
该基准,连同详细的数据分解和元数据,在我们GitHub寄存器[13]0 0中公开提供;没有重新分配原始图像;寄存器只提供分解的文件/识别符和元数据. 原始数据必须从原始数据集提供者获取. 。 。 。 。
这些数据集在分辨率、收集环境和天气条件方面各不相同,为培训和评价提供了不同的领域。

blocks.en:
The source domain is composed of five publicly available weather datasets—Weather Classification [ 5 ] , DAWN [ 6 ] , WEDGE [ 14 ] , WEAPD [ 15 ] , and WSPFI [ 1 ] —which together offer diverse illumination, visibility, and sensor characteristics.
The target domain corresponds to the Street-View dataset, which contains outdoor traffic-scene images exhibiting realistic weather degradation patterns such as fog, snow, rain, and sandstorm effects.
Target labels are used only for evaluation, consistent with the unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) setting.
blocks.zh:
源域由5个公开的气象数据集组成——Weather Class [5],DAWN [6],WEDGE [14],WEAPD [15],和WSPFI [1]——它们共同提供了不同的发光,能见度,和传感器特性.
目标域与"街-维尤"数据集相对应,该数据集包含户外交通-场景图像,展现出雾,雪,雨等真实的天气退化模式和沙暴效应.
目标标签只用于评价,与未监管域适应(UDA)设置一致.

blocks.en:
Table I summarizes the number of samples per weather category in both the source and target domains.
Although large-scale Street-View datasets exist for the Clear condition, images corresponding to adverse weather types such as Fog , Sand , and Rain are relatively scarce, making direct supervised training on street-view data impractical [ 12 ] .
To mitigate the impact of class imbalance, all source and target samples are re-weighted during training so that each weather category contributes equally to the loss function.
During training, random horizontal flipping and mild color jittering are applied as data augmentation to improve robustness to illumination and appearance shifts.
blocks.zh:
表一汇总了源域和目标域每个天气类别样本的数量。
虽然Clear条件存在大规模街-View数据集,但与雾,沙,雨等恶劣天气类型对应的图像相对稀少,使得街景数据的直接监督培训不切实际 [12].
为了减轻班级不平衡的影响,在训练期间对所有源和标本进行再加权,使每个天气类别都对损失功能作出同等的贡献.
在训练期间,随机水平翻转和轻度颜色分解被作为数据增强来应用来提高发光和外观变化的强度.

All reported results correspond to the average of three independent runs with different random seeds.
This unified benchmark provides a consistent and challenging setting for evaluating domain-invariant weather recognition across multiple source distributions and a visually distinct target environment.

这一统一基准为评价多种源分布的域-变化性天气识别和视觉上独特的目标环境提供了一个连贯而有挑战性的环境。

blocks.en: IV-B Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 四-B 执行详情

blocks.en:
All experiments are implemented in PyTorch and conducted on an NVIDIA RTX A2000 GPU.
We evaluate four backbone networks as feature extractors: ResNet-50, EfficientNet-B0, VGG16-BN, and DenseNet-121, each initialized with ImageNet-pretrained weights.
The classifier head consists of two fully connected layers with batch normalization and ReLU activation, followed by a softmax layer producing probabilities over five weather categories.
blocks.zh:
所有实验都用PyTorch进行,并以NVIDIA RTX A2000 GPU进行.
我们评价四个主干网作为特性提取器:ResNet-50、高效率的Net-B0、VGG16-BN和DenseNet-121,每个网由ImageNet预先调整的权重初始化。
分级器头由两个全相通的层组成,具有批量正常化和ReLU活化,再由软马克斯层产生出五种天气类别的概率.

blocks.en:
During the source pretraining stage, all models are optimized using stochastic gradient descent (SGD) with a learning rate of 10 − 3 10^{-3} , momentum of 0.9, and weight decay of 10 − 4 10^{-4} .
Training continues for 30 epochs with a batch size of 64.
blocks.zh:
在源前训练阶段,所有型号都采用分层梯度下降(SGD)进行优化,学习率为10−3 10^{-3},动力为0.9,重量衰减为10−4 10^{-4}.
继续培训30个世纪,批量规模为64个。

blocks.en:
During the adversarial adaptation phase, the target feature extractor ( Mt ) and discriminator ( D ) are jointly optimized using the Adam optimizer.
Batch normalization layers are fixed in evaluation mode, and only the final high-level convolutional stages of each backbone are unfrozen for adaptation.
Each experiment is repeated three times with different random seeds, and the mean performance is reported.
blocks.zh:
在对抗性的适应阶段,目标特征提取器(Mt)和歧义取取取器(D)使用亚当优化器共同优化.
批量正常化层被固定在评价模式中,只有每个骨干的最后高阶分层才被解冻以适应.
每个实验用不同的随机种子重复三次,平均性能被报告.

These values are empirically selected for stable convergence and fair comparison across architectures.

根据经验选择这些价值是为了在各种结构之间实现稳定的趋同和公平比较。

blocks.en: IV-C Baselines
blocks.zh: 四-C 基线

blocks.en:
To evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed WA-ADDA framework, we compare it against two representative baselines implemented under the same training and evaluation pipeline described in Section IV-B.
All methods share identical data preprocessing, network initialization, and optimization settings to ensure a fair comparison.
blocks.zh:
为了评价拟议的WA-ADDA框架的效力,我们把它同在第四节B所描述的同一培训和评价程序下执行的两个有代表性的基线进行比较。
所有方法都共享相同的数据预处理,网络初始化和优化设置,以确保公平比较.

blocks.en:
1) Source-Only: A model trained solely on the aggregated multi-source dataset without any domain adaptation.
This baseline quantifies the domain gap between source and target distributions and serves as a lower performance bound.
blocks.zh:
1) Source-Only:一个完全在集合多源数据集上训练而没有任何域调整的模型.
这一基线对源与目标分布之间的域间隙进行量化,并起到较低的性能约束作用.

blocks.en:
2) ADDA [ 18 ] :
The Adversarial Discriminative Domain Adaptation framework, which first pretrains a source encoder and classifier, then learns a target encoder ( Mt ) through adversarial training against a domain discriminator.
The discriminator distinguishes source and target features, while the target encoder aims to produce domain-invariant representations.
This model serves as the primary baseline for evaluating the impact of our classifier-aware extension.
blocks.zh:
(2) 裁军部[18]:
Adversari-discriminal Domain 适应框架,它首先预设了源编码器和分类器,然后通过对抗域歧视器的对抗训练来学习目标编码器(Mt.).
歧视者区分出源与目标特征,而目标编码器则旨在产生域-变量表示.
这一模型是评估我们分级认识扩展的影响的主要基线。

blocks.en:
3) WA-ADDA (Ours): Our proposed Weather-Aware ADDA extends the standard ADDA framework with two key modifications:
(i) the discriminator jointly receives both feature-level embeddings and classifier logits, enabling alignment of semantic structure in addition to domain-level features; and
(ii) entropy minimization and consistency regularization are applied to stabilize adversarial training and reduce pseudo-label noise.
These additions encourage better inter-class separation and more robust target-domain adaptation under adverse weather variations.
blocks.zh:
3) WA-ADDA(我们):我们提议的Weather-Aware ADDA扩展了ADA标准框架,进行了两项关键修改:
(一) 歧视者联合接收地物层嵌入和分级日志,从而除了域级特征之外,还能够对语义结构进行调整;
(二) 将乙烯最小化和一致性规范化,以稳定对抗性训练并减少伪标签噪音。
这些增加鼓励在不利的天气变化中更好地进行分级和更加有力的目标领域适应。

blocks.en:
All models are trained for 30 epochs using early stopping based on target-domain macro accuracy.
Reported results include both overall and macro accuracy, averaged over three independent runs with different random seeds.
This controlled comparison isolates the contributions of feature–logit coupling and regularization within the proposed WA-ADDA framework relative to the standard ADDA baseline.
blocks.zh:
所有模型都根据目标域的宏精度使用早期停止来为30个纪元进行训练.
报告的结果包括总体准确度和宏观准确度,平均为3个不同随机种子的独立跑道。
这种有控制的比较将特征-逻辑结合和规范化对拟议的WA-ADDA框架内与ADA标准基线相比的贡献隔离开来。

blocks.en: IV-D Quantitative Results
blocks.zh: 四-D 量化结果

blocks.en:
Table III reports the macro accuracy , overall accuracy , and per-class accuracy on the source dataset.
As expected, all backbone networks achieve consistently high performance in this setting, confirming that the source models are well-trained and provide a strong initialization for subsequent domain adaptation.
These results serve as an upper-bound reference and ensure that performance differences observed on the target domain are primarily due to domain shift rather than insufficient source supervision.
blocks.zh:
表 三 报告源数据集的宏观准确度,总体准确度,以及每类准确度.
如所料,所有骨干网络在这一背景下都实现了一贯的高性能,证实了源模型训练有素,为后期域名适应提供了强大的初始化.
这些结果作为上限的参考,并确保在目标领域观察到的性能差异主要出自域位转移而不是出自不充分的源监督.

blocks.en:
Table IV summarizes the quantitative performance on the Street-View target dataset.
Both ADDA and the proposed WA-ADDA significantly outperform the Source-Only baseline across all backbones, highlighting the necessity of adversarial domain adaptation under severe appearance changes induced by adverse weather conditions.
blocks.zh:
表四总结了街道-村目标数据集的量化绩效.
非洲工发十年和拟议的西澳大利亚-非洲工发十年在所有骨干部门都大大地超过了 " 仅源 " 基线,突出表明必须在恶劣天气条件引起的严重外观变化下进行对抗性领域调整。

blocks.en:
Across architectures, WA-ADDA consistently achieves strong macro and overall accuracy, often matching or surpassing classical ADDA while exhibiting more balanced per-class behavior.
In particular, WA-ADDA shows pronounced improvements in adverse weather categories such as Fog , Rain , and Sand , where visibility degradation and illumination changes introduce substantial domain shifts.
At the same time, performance on the Clear category is preserved, indicating that improved alignment does not come at the expense of discriminative power in favorable conditions.
blocks.zh:
在整个架构中,WA-ADDA始终实现强大的宏观和整体准确性,常常匹配或超越了经典的ADDA,同时表现出更平衡的一等行为.
特别是,WA-ADDA显示,雾、雨和沙等不利天气类别有了显著改善,可见度退化和光照变化带来了大量的域位转移。
同时,Clear类别的绩效得到保留,这表明改进配对不会以有利条件下的歧视性权力为代价。

blocks.en:
While ADDA occasionally attains very high accuracy on individual classes (e.g., Fog or Snow), this is often accompanied by noticeable degradation in other categories, leading to less stable macro performance.
In contrast, WA-ADDA promotes more uniform class-wise generalization, resulting in improved robustness across diverse weather conditions. Additionally, as shown in Fig. 2 , WA-ADDA demonstrates stable performance across different random seeds, exhibiting only a small variance in macro accuracy on the Street-View target set.
blocks.zh:
虽然非洲工业发展十年偶尔在个别类别(如雾或斯诺等)中达到非常高的准确度,但与此同时,其他类别往往明显退化,导致宏观性能不稳定。
相形之下,WA-ADDA则促进更统一的分级通缩,从而在各种天气条件下改善稳健性. 此外,如图2所显示的,WA-ADDA显示不同随机种子的性能稳定,在街景指标集的宏观准确度仅显示出小幅差异.

blocks.en: The consistent gains observed across ResNet-50, DenseNet-121, EfficientNet-B0, and VGG16-BN confirm that the proposed approach is backbone-agnostic and generalizes well across different network architectures.
blocks.zh: 在整个ResNet-50、DenseNet-121、高效率的Net-B0和VGG16-BN中观察到的一致进展证实,拟议办法具有骨干不可知性,并广泛涵盖不同的网络结构。

blocks.en: IV-E Qualitative Results
blocks.zh: 四-E 定性结果

blocks.en:
To qualitatively analyze the effect of adversarial adaptation on feature representations, we visualize source and target embeddings using t-SNE projections in Fig. 3 .
Each column corresponds to a backbone network, while rows show the feature distributions obtained from the source-only model, ADDA, and the proposed WA-ADDA, respectively.
blocks.zh:
为了从质量上分析对抗性修改对地物表现的影响,我们用图3中的t-SNE预测将源和目标嵌入进行可视化.
每个栏目对应一个主干网,而行则分别显示从唯源模型ADA和拟议的WA-ADA获得的特性分布.

blocks.en:
In the source-only setting, source and target samples form clearly separated clusters across all backbones, reflecting the strong domain discrepancy caused by variations in weather conditions, illumination, and visibility.
This separation is particularly evident for EfficientNet-B0 and VGG16-BN, where target samples occupy distinct regions in the embedding space.
blocks.zh:
在仅源设置中,源与目标样本在所有主干上形成明显分离的集群,反映了由天气条件、发光和能见度等变化造成的强烈域差异。
这种分离对于高效Net-B0和VGG16-BN特别明显,在嵌入空间中目标样本占据了不同的区域.

blocks.en: Fig. 3: t-SNE visualizations of source and target feature distributions for different backbones before adaptation (source-only) and after adaptation using ADDA and the proposed WA-ADDA. Each column corresponds to one backbone, and each row corresponds to one training setting.
blocks.zh: 图3:T-SNE在适应前(仅以源为主)以及在适应后使用ADA和拟议的WA-ADA对源和目标地物进行可视化分布. 每列对应一个骨干,每行对应一个训练设置.

blocks.en:
After applying ADDA, partial alignment between source and target features is observed.
While some target clusters move closer to the source distribution, the embeddings often remain fragmented or elongated, indicating unstable alignment and class-wise imbalance.
This behavior is consistent with the quantitative results, where ADDA improves certain classes while degrading others.
blocks.zh:
在应用ADA后,观察到源与目标特性的部分相配.
虽然一些目标集群更接近于源分布,但嵌入物往往仍然支离破碎或被延长,表明对接不稳定和等级失衡.
这种行为与定量结果一致,其中ADA改进了某些阶级,而贬低了其他阶级.

blocks.en:
In contrast, WA-ADDA produces more coherent and semantically meaningful feature distributions.
Target embeddings are better integrated into the source feature space, with reduced fragmentation and improved overlap across multiple clusters.
Although perfect overlap is neither expected nor required, the smoother and more structured alignment observed with WA-ADDA suggests that incorporating classifier-aware information into the discriminator leads to more stable semantic alignment.
These qualitative observations closely mirror the improved macro accuracy and balanced per-class performance reported in Table IV .
blocks.zh:
相比之下,WA-ADDA制作的地物分布更加一致并具有针对性。
目标嵌入更能被整合入源地特征空间,并减少分化,改善多个集群的重叠.
虽然不期望也不要求完全重叠,但与WA-ADDA比较平稳和结构更加有序的调整表明,将了解分类的信息纳入歧视者,会导致语义上的更稳定的调整。
这些定性观察密切反映了表四所报告的宏观准确性和平衡的每类业绩。

blocks.en: V Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en:
This paper addressed multi-class weather recognition under severe domain shift, where labeled street-view data are scarce and existing weather datasets differ substantially from real driving imagery.
To bridge this gap, we proposed Weather-Aware Adversarial Discriminative Domain Adaptation (WA-ADDA), which extends ADDA by conditioning the domain discriminator on classifier predictions, thereby enabling semantically informed feature alignment.
blocks.zh:
本文涉及在严重域位转移下多级天气识别,其中标注的街景数据稀缺,而现有的天气数据集与真实的驱动图像相去甚远.
为了弥补这一差距,我们提议采用天气-认知的横向差别域适应(WA-ADDA),通过在分类器预测方面对域进行区分来扩展ADA,从而能够对特征进行精密的知情调整。

blocks.en:
Comprehensive experiments on a multi-source → \rightarrow street-view benchmark show that WA-ADDA consistently outperforms source-only training and classical ADDA across multiple backbone architectures.
As reported in Table IV, the proposed method achieves higher macro and overall accuracy with more balanced per-class performance, particularly under adverse weather conditions such as fog, rain, and sand.
Qualitative t-SNE visualizations further confirm improved alignment between source and target feature distributions.
blocks.zh:
关于多来源综合实验 \ 右旋街景基准显示,WA-ADDA在多个骨干结构中一贯优于只来源培训和经典的ADDA。
如表四所报告,拟议方法实现了更高的宏观和总体准确性,每个班级的性能更加平衡,特别是在雾、雨和沙等不利天气条件下。
定性 t-SNE可视化进一步证实了源与目标特征分布之间更好的对接.

blocks.en:
Overall, WA-ADDA provides a simple yet effective framework for weather-aware domain adaptation without requiring target annotations.
The method is backbone-agnostic and can be readily integrated into vision-based perception systems, offering a practical solution for robust weather recognition in real-world driving scenarios.
blocks.zh:
总体而言,WA-ADDA提供了一个简单而有效的适应天气意识域的框架,不需要目标说明。
该方法具有骨干-可知性,可以随时被整合入以视觉为基础的感知系统,为在现实世界的驱动情景中强健地识别天气提供了一个切实可行的解决方案.
